original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 0 System BIOS Major Release component matches the approved numeric release contract and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete Type 0 and a representation that preserves the major/minor BIOS revision components, extract the major byte/value under documented tool behavior, compare to the platform recipe, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected major component and plan. Collection, component parsing, reboot and persistence comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Documented dmidecode/script mapping of combined BIOS Revision
safety_requirements: Do not assume the literal source field is a dmidecode label; verify representation and preserve raw output/errors.
Do not compare the full BIOS Version string as a substitute for the major-release component.
Stop on not-specified sentinel, parsing ambiguity, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw Type 0/tool identity, extract the major component from a verified representation and compare before/after reboot.
Do not invent mapping/expectation, change firmware or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the numeric component, applicability/sentinel rule and reboot recovery.
Resolve representation discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Fragile: the searched literal may not exist in dmidecode human-readable output, which commonly combines major/minor as BIOS Revision; errors and transport security are also mishandled.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full sudo dmidecode -t 0 and version/error output, verify how the installed tool renders revision components, and extract the major value deterministically before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The linked script, major-release scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record raw/decoded major and minor components, the combined display if present and not-specified sentinel handling, then compare the major component with the approved numeric recipe across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 0 revisions implementing the System BIOS release fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode/script and BIOS versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform SMBIOS Type 0 field baseline and approved tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces literal-label grep with verified component extraction.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; it proves the actual major component rather than a nearby version string.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected major value and representation mapping.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor BIOS Version text and SMBIOS numeric revision components may intentionally differ.

project_override_considerations: A project may define the expected component or not-specified behavior for its firmware. It must not substitute the marketing BIOS Version string without documenting equivalence.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected major/applicability, platform and tool versions
Raw pre-reboot Type 0 plus component mapping

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion are coherent; exact component value and rendering are project/tool inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The SMBIOS field is semantically defined. Missing expectation or confirmed renderer affects readiness, not the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains Type 0 collection but rejects literal-label/filter assumptions.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps exact-value and recovery controls while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Distinguishes the numeric major component from the BIOS Version string.

review_improvement: Avoids a false empty result or comparison of the wrong Type 0 version field.
independent_technical_reasoning: After approval, collection, reboot and component comparison are software-controlled with no human UI action, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE applies.
